verdict.rationale: MX's Instant Account Verification connects to an end user's institution and retrieves account and routing numbers for demand deposit accounts. Tokenized Account Numbers (TANs) are documented as substitutes for secure ACH money movement. Microdeposits are offered as a separate, alternate method, so IAV works without them. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and documented detail on which institutions return TANs versus raw numbers.
